description: Use the selected LARK M2 transmitter button to start and stop the existing Domios voice recorder.
configHelp: Grant local recording, then enable LARK and explicitly select the connected receiver and LARK microphone in the host picker. Choose a recipient using its tab menu. Double-press to start the existing voice recorder; double-press again to stop and send through the configured Transcriber. No receiver means no capture. Windows support requires the matching host wiring. macOS mapping and hardware verification remain pending.
